policy_name: Acme Fictional Co. Travel & Expense Policy

meals.limit_applies_to: sum of all meal receipts on the same calendar date

receipts.note: Every line item must have a receipt containing all required fields.

decision_rules.if: any receipt is missing a required field
decision_rules.note: Ask the employee for the missing details. Never guess or invent values.

decision_rules.if: any expense is explicitly non-reimbursable (e.g. alcohol, non-economy airfare)

decision_rules.note: Explain which limit was exceeded and by how much.

disclaimer: The agent only RECOMMENDS a decision. A human finance reviewer makes the actual approval.
